run_throughput_benchmark: run a throughput benchmark against a TorchServe model using JMeter and Docker
run_latency_benchmark: run a latency benchmark against a TorchServe model with single threaded JMeter requests
run_ping_benchmark: run a ping benchmark to measure TorchServe frontend request throughput with 5000 threads
run_concurrent_inference_benchmark: run a concurrent inference benchmark testing multiple thread counts against a TorchServe model
run_multiple_models_benchmark: run a benchmark that loads and tests five models simultaneously on TorchServe
